decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program supports the firm's service-led positioning and stayed visible through 2024, so despite some overlap risk with other express offers it is more likely to be retained.

The seventy-two-hour express program is operationally demanding and somewhat niche, but its continued presence in 2024 suggests it still strengthens the firm's fast-response value proposition enough to keep it on the market.
This dedicated express program for doors and gates had its own page in both 2023 and 2024, indicating strategic importance and a good fit with the firm's core business and logistics capabilities.
The online ordering and digital services platform aligns closely with the firm's move toward deeper advisory and service support and is therefore very likely to remain a strategic priority.

The fire and smoke protection door gained prominence from a website mention in 2023 to its own page in 2024, which points to strong demand and a strong fit with the firm's safety-compliance strengths.
